integrity: Exact finite-state polynomial balance equations and a standalone integer-polynomial checker are supplied. Published source results and the one-floor baseline are credited.
scientific_limitations: Stationary simultaneous covariance only, for exactly two sites, capacities c=1,2,3, and equal boundary rates 0<t<=1.
No extension to c>=4, unequal rates, longer chains or dynamic covariances is proved.
No claim of independent review or publication priority; inaccessible and unindexed prior work remains possible.
title: A capacity-three correlation threshold in a two-site back-pressure exclusion chain
